content: Approval workflow DB design: two viable patterns are (1) add a status/state column directly on the row (e.g. pending_delete) or (2) a separate queue/transaction table referencing the original row. For small multi-entity-type systems, a single shared queue table with a polymorphic (entity_type, entity_id) reference plus status is commonly recommended over per-table status columns to avoid duplicating approval logic across tables.
